eval_dimensions.name: Spoken Turn Shape
eval_dimensions.description: A spoken turn is a headline with counts, at most two callsign items, and at most one question — three sentences at most, with no ticket, PR, commit or mailbox numbers before the text-session divider.

eval_dimensions.name: One Decision per Turn
eval_dimensions.description: Pending decisions are queued as tasks; exactly one is asked per turn, through AskUserQuestion in a Claude Code hub, with the recommended option first.

eval_dimensions.name: Screen-Only Routing
eval_dimensions.description: Code reviews, diffs, visual QA and long documents become [screen] tasks with a link; voice mentions only their count and callsigns.

eval_dimensions.name: Task Tracking
eval_dimensions.description: Creates the 'Supervise sessions by voice' task at invocation.

evals.name: Board summary in callsign words
evals.description: The supervisor asks 'what needs me?' while one session needs input, two work and one is done.
evals.input: board.py prints Needs you (1) payments migration [dev10x-7], Working (2), Done (1) checkout copy [tt-2] with PR #412

assertions.signal: The spoken part names 'the payments migration' and 'the checkout copy' and contains no '#412', 'dev10x-7', 'tt-2' or 'GH-' token before the text-session divider
The spoken part has at most three sentences and at most one question mark

evals.name: Several decisions collapse to one question
evals.description: Three sessions each wait on a supervisor decision; the hub is a Claude Code session.
evals.input: Board shows three needs-input sessions with different questions

assertions.signal: Each pending decision is recorded as a 'Decide:' task before the supervisor is asked
The questions array has exactly one entry; its first option carries (Recommended)
No plain-text multi-part question substitutes for the AskUserQuestion call

evals.name: Code review is queued, not read aloud
evals.description: A session finishes and its PR needs the supervisor's code review.
evals.input: Notice 'login fix: done' with a PR link that needs review

assertions.signal: A '[screen] login fix — …' task is created with needs_screen=true and the PR link in metadata
The spoken part says the review waits for the screen and reads no diff, file path or line number

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the voice-supervisor skill

should_trigger.query: what needs me across my sessions? I'm on voice
I'm driving all the sessions by voice from Cowork today, keep it short

should_not_trigger.query: connect this session to the bus
review this PR diff with me
should_not_trigger.rationale: Screen work in one session, no voice hub
